title: Laptop Sample
description: A screenshot-delivered baseline walkthrough of the six high-level steps for taking a Mission Surface prototype from starter download to Request dashboard feedback.
limitations: GitHub connection, publishing, comments, and feedback submission are represented as page images
No files are downloaded and no changes are persisted

screenshots.altText: Dark Mission Surface setup path showing download, GitHub connection, and live or image delivery choices
Dark Mission Surface review path showing verification, contextual review, comments, and Request dashboard feedback

items.content: Evaluate whether the choice between GitHub Pages and local image preparation is clear within the setup sequence.
Evaluate whether contextual review and the handoff to the Request dashboard feel like one connected feedback loop.
